raw.title: Art
raw.description: Creative work to evoke aesthetic response
raw.extract: Art is a diverse range of human activity centered around works, crafted as an expression of creativity or imagination, which are expected to provide an audience with a worthwhile experience—generally, an experience of emotion, thinking, or beauty.
